a1-copula.title: The Noun-Class Copula: ву / ю / ду
a1-copula.pattern: [subject] + ву (masculine) / ю (feminine) / ду (default, abstract) -- negative: вац / яц / дац
a1-copula.explanation: Chechen's "to be" isn't one fixed word -- it changes shape to agree with the grammatical class of its subject. A male referent takes ву (Со дика ву -- I am well, said by a man), a female referent takes ю (Со дика ю -- said by a woman), and most other subjects -- abstract statements and categories -- take ду. Each has a matching negative: вац, яц, дац.
a1-copula.fact: This class-agreement system is one of the defining features of the Northeast Caucasian language family Chechen belongs to -- the same в-/й-/д- markers shown here on the copula reappear as prefixes on many other verbs and adjectives throughout the language, not just this one word. A fourth form, бу, exists for a further noun class (confirmed textbook examples: малх бу -- "there is sun/it's sunny", and Iаж бу -- "it's an apple") -- its full usage range isn't covered here yet, only these two specific attested words.

dialogue.native: Со хьан ваша ву. Со дика ву.
dialogue.en: I am your brother. I am well.

a1-pronouns.title: Personal Pronouns & Their Genitive (Possessive) Forms
a1-pronouns.pattern: со→сан (my) · хьо→хьан (your) · иза→цуьнан (his/her) · тхо→тхан (our, excl.) · вай→вайн (our, incl.) · шу→шун (your, pl.) · уьш→церан (their)
a1-pronouns.explanation: Chechen forms possessives by putting the personal pronoun into its genitive case, not with a separate possessive word: со (I) becomes сан (my), хьо (you) becomes хьан (your), иза (he/she/it) becomes цуьнан (his/her). Chechen also splits "we" in two: тхо/тхан excludes the listener, вай/вайн includes them.
a1-pronouns.fact: The noun "name" (цIе) is grammatically feminine (й-class) no matter whose name is being given -- Сан цIе Ахьмад ю ("My name is Ahmad") takes ю even though Ahmad himself would take ву -- the copula agrees with цIе, the word for "name" itself, not with the person it names.

dialogue.native: Сан цIе Ахьмад ю. Хьан цIе хIун ю?
dialogue.en: My name is Ahmad. What is your name?
